rationale: The original thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still above session VWAP (49.26), sitting right on the 9-EMA (49.37), and compressing in a 2-cent range just under the day high, with invalidation at 49.30 not threatened. Risk from here is only ~7 cents (~$14) versus ~13 cents (~$26) to the 49.50 target, so scratching a flat position ahead of its stated invalidation discards a still-live 1.5:1 setup. The dead 1m volume and negligible MFE are yellow flags, not reversal signals, and nothing in the tape (no VWAP break, no lower lows, no SPY deterioration beyond -0.21%) supports closing, let alone flipping short.
